007package com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.agent;
008
009import com.oracle.database.selectai.agent.SelectAIAgent;
010import com.oracle.database.selectai.agent.Task;
011import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.DbConnectionConfig;
012import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.SelectAIException;
013
014import java.util.List;
015
016/**
017 * Lists agent tasks owned by the connected database user.
018 *
019 * <p>Set {@code SELECTAI_DB_USER}, {@code SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD}, and
020 * {@code SELECTAI_JDBC_URL} before running this sample. The database user must
021 * have access to Select AI Agent metadata. Optionally set
022 * {@code SELECTAI_AGENT_TASK_NAME_PATTERN} to a database regular expression
023 * for case-insensitive filtering. See {@code samples/README.md} for
024 * build and run commands.</p>
025 */
026public final class ListTasksSample {
027
028    private ListTasksSample() {
029    }
030
031    /**
032     * Runs the sample and propagates failures to the command-line caller.
033     *
034     * @param args command-line arguments; not used
035     * @throws SelectAIException when an SDK operation fails
036     */
037    public static void main(String[] args) throws SelectAIException {
038        try (SelectAIAgent client = createClient()) {
039            String pattern = optionalEnv("SELECTAI_AGENT_TASK_NAME_PATTERN");
040            List<Task> tasks = pattern == null ? client.listTasks() : client.listTasks(pattern);
041            System.out.printf("Found %d task(s).%n", tasks.size());
042            for (Task task : tasks) {
043                System.out.printf("Task: %s; description: %s%n",
044                        task.getTaskName(), task.getDescription());
045            }
046        }
047    }
048
049    private static SelectAIAgent createClient() throws SelectAIException {
050        return SelectAIAgent.create(DbConnectionConfig.builder()
051                .dbUser(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_USER"))
052                .dbPassword(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD"))
053                .jdbcUrl(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_JDBC_URL"))
054                .build());
055    }
056
057    private static String requiredEnv(String name) {
058        String value = System.getenv(name);
059        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
060            throw new IllegalStateException("Missing required environment variable: " + name);
061        }
062        return value;
063    }
064
065    private static String optionalEnv(String name) {
066        String value = System.getenv(name);
067        return value == null || value.isBlank() ? null : value;
068    }
069}
